item.title: Longjili Trading Recalls Pamag Pieeoo Mattresses Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fire Hazard; Violate Mandatory Standard for Mattress Flammability
item.company: Sold Online At: Amazon.com in March 2026 for between $80 and $95.
item.brand: Sold Online At: Amazon.com in March 2026 for between $80 and $95.
item.summary: This recall involves Pamag Pieeoo Mattresses. The mattresses are 8 inches thick and were sold in a twin-XL size. They have a white top and white sides with a gray curve pattern. They were sold compressed in a box. The date of manufacture and “Model: BFC8HMBYTX-US” and care instructions are printed on a sewn-in white label located on one side of the mattress.
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased: Pamag Pieeoo Mattresses.
item.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled mattresses immediately and contact Longjili Trading for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to destroy the mattress by writing in permanent marker “RECALLED,” on the top surface of the mattress and send a photo of the marked mattress to Pamagpieeoo@outlook.com. Consumers should then dispose of the recalled product.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
